verdict.rationale: Oneleet is a security and compliance platform, so user-defined event-triggered automation rules are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows only built-in or adjacent behaviors: daily scheduled scans, a CI check that blocks new issues in pull requests, controls added automatically when a framework is selected, and AI agents collecting evidence on a schedule. None of these is a documented way for users to define their own rules that fire actions on events.
